newsitem.title: FRANCE: Trade confirms first Tunis new-crop barley tender.
newsitem.headline: Trade confirms first Tunis new-crop barley tender.

text.p: Tunisia has launched a tender for 100,000 tonnes of any-origin barley for shipment between May and August -- the first from the region to include new-crop positions, European grain exporters confirmed on Tuesday.
The closing date for the tender is January 30.
The next European Union commercial crop year starts on July 1, 1997. However, the origin is likely to be decided at the time of loading, traders said.
Tunisia is calling for four shipments of 25,000 tonnes each.
Earlier, traders in Tunisia gave the following shipment dates -- 10-20 May, 10-20 June, 10-20 July and 10-20 August.
